Dominant mapped geological period in the study area, by GIS mapped area. Scale: 1 = Pre-Nectarian (>3.92 Ga), 2 = Nectarian (3.92–3.85 Ga), 3 = Imbrian (3.85–3.16 Ga), 4 = Eratosthenian (3.16–0.8 Ga), 5 = Copernican (0.8 Ga to present).
m relative to 1,737.4 km reference sphere
1 = Metamorphic; 2 = Sedimentary; 3 = Igneous (original request codes; not a good lunar rock classification).
1 = smoothest, 5 = roughest; quintiles across these 30 LQs using mean 1° grid slope; upper cutoffs 0.80°, 1.47°, 1.75°, 1.99°, 3.09°. Relative macro-roughness proxy only.
1 mare basalt regolith; 2 highland/terra regolith; 3 crater ejecta/breccia; 4 basin ejecta/lineated deposits; 5 mixed/plains or unresolved. Not an ordinal quality rank.

1 = Pre-Nectarian (>3.92 Ga); 2 = Nectarian (3.92–3.85); 3 = Imbrian (3.85–3.16); 4 = Eratosthenian (3.16–0.8); 5 = Copernican (0.8 Ga–present). Value is the dominant mapped period by USGS GIS unit area; feature-age proxies are separately noted.
